name: TelegArm
author: hamed7ir
description: TelegArm is a Telegram client for Windows RT and Windows 10 ARM32. The official Telegram apps don't run on these devices anymore, so I made this one. It runs on normal Windows PCs too. It's written in C# and talks to Telegram with WTelegramClient. Voice calls, video calls and group voice chats use Telegram's own call library (tgcalls), and videos and music play with FFmpeg. One build runs on Windows RT 8.0 and 8.1, Windows 10 ARM32, and Windows 8.1, 10 and 11 (x86, x64 and ARM64). Calls need Windows 8.1 or newer. Windows 7 is not tested yet, and calls don't work there. You need .NET Framework 4.7 or newer. Windows RT 8.1 comes with 4.5, so install 4.7 first, and RT 8.0 needs the .NET 4.8 update, which is hard to find.
dependencies: Windows RT 8.0 only: the .NET Framework 4.8 update. It's hard to find for RT 8.0 right now.
Windows 8.1 or newer for voice and video calls
instructionSteps: On Windows RT, jailbreak the device first. RT only runs unsigned desktop apps after a jailbreak.
Install .NET Framework 4.7 or newer first. On Windows RT 8.1 get it here: https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2088632. Windows 10 ARM32 already has it.
On Windows RT 8.0 install the .NET Framework 4.8 update first. The app won't start without it, and it's hard to find for RT 8.0 right now.
Run TelegArm-2.0.0-Setup.exe. It checks .NET for you and gives you the link if it's missing.
Voice and video calls need Windows 8.1 or newer.
On Windows 7 also install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015 or newer redistributable (x86). TelegArm works without it, but animated stickers won't move.
Upgrading from 1.9: your accounts and settings carry over.
